get-the-yes.description:
GET THE YES 1.0 is an online masterclass that teaches you how to land high-ticket clients and the career opportunities you want. It’s hosted by Dr. Dan Odotukpono and Susana Otokpa.
Over a focused programme, you learn how to position yourself, start the right conversations and turn them into a “yes”, whether that’s a paying client or an offer from an employer. There are three ways to join: the 4-day masterclass, the 10-day challenge (the best value) or VIP mentorship.
The event starts on 28 November, with free sessions on 14 and 21 November.
